raw_text:
{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "Crypt-iQ",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "identified static destruction order bug causing CI failures and asked about a deadlock"
    },
    {
      "login": "fanquake",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "pinged marcofleon"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5847537220",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "In process_message(s), static testing_setup is destructed before static g_filter_indexes, causing BaseIndex::Stop to access already-destructed testing_setup.m_node",
      "quote": "I think CI failures are because in process_message(s) the `static testing_setup` is destructed before `static g_filter_indexes` so `BaseIndex::Stop` will try to access `testing_setup.m_node`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that it was fixed by destroying indexes in testing destructor",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4135882991"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4135882991",
      "status_by_quote": "Thx, fixed by destroying the indexes in the testing dtor, which seems useful generally, unrelated to the changes here."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4111988346",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Why does it deadlock?",
      "quote": "Can you explain why it deadlocks? I couldn't figure this bit out",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained the deadlock mechanism involving cs_main and ImmediateBackgroundTaskRunner",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4135869158"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4135869158",
      "status_by_quote": "Thus, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/3b9768a07aee6851de24f9c23bcdeeac2d872d23/src/kernel/chain.cpp#L25 will deadlock via callback thread: BaseIndex::BlockConnected() → ProcessBlock() → kernel::MakeBlockInfo() → tries to lock cs_main"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "Crypt-iQ to check the deadlock explanation and destructor fix",
      "id": "rc:4135882991"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author replied answering Crypt-iQ's question on why deadlocks happen and stated that destruction order was fixed in the testing dtor. fanquake pinged marcofleon."
}
